scopeSemantics.user: Installs to the invoking user's home directory (~/.copilot, ~/.claude, ~/.gemini). Available across every project on that machine. Never committed to any repo.
scopeSemantics.workspace: Installs into the current project/repo root (.github, .claude, .gemini). Committed to git, shared with the team.

notes.principles: principles/*.md is per-repo generated content, not manifest-tracked like agents/skills/instructions - see CONTRIBUTING.md.
